fonts.note: The catalog is set in Avenir. Macs and iPhones have it built in; everyone else sees the web font, its closest free cousin from Google Fonts.

text_colors.name: Ink
text_colors.use: All text: body text and headings (Pantone Cool Gray 11 C)

text_colors.name: RemPhos blue
text_colors.use: Links and highlights on RemPhos pages (Pantone 7686 CP)

text_colors.name: Light Efficient Design green
text_colors.use: Links and highlights on Light Efficient Design pages

text_colors.name: Solera gold
text_colors.use: Links and highlights on Solera pages

brand_colors.name: Light Efficient Design green
brand_colors.use: Pantone 377 C. Brand strips, dots and bands. Too light for small text: text uses the darker green above.

brand_colors.name: RemPhos blue
brand_colors.use: Pantone 7686 CP. Brand strips, dots, bands and buttons

brand_colors.name: Solera yellow
brand_colors.use: Pantone 7406 CP. The Solera band at the top of every solar page. Never for text on white, except where listed below.

text_sizes.name: Small
text_sizes.use: Small buttons and tags (14 px, Avenir Heavy)

text_sizes.name: Body
text_sizes.use: Body text and subheaders (20 px; body in Avenir Roman, subheaders in Avenir Black)

text_sizes.name: Header
text_sizes.use: Section headers (40 px, Avenir Heavy, capitals)

exceptions.what: Background in Cool Gray 11 (#55565A), the brand text colour, with white text
exceptions.why: The footer colour in the new home page design
